description: Per-symbol field contract for market_data/technicals/latest.json (nousergon-data collectors/metron_market_data.py::collect_technicals, computed via features.feature_engineer._compute_rsi / _compute_macd -- the SAME functions the CATALOG-governed write path uses, though this artifact is a separate JSON namespace with its own field names, not features/registry.py::CATALOG columns; grep-verified 2026-09-14: metron reads NO features/{date}/*.parquet snapshot directly and NO registry.CATALOG-named column. This artifact is the real, measured coupling to nousergon-data's feature computation -- a units/scale drift here (e.g. a fraction silently becoming a percent, the avg_volume_20d shape) is the same defect class, one hop from CATALOG naming rather than through it. Consumer: api.services.technicals.TickerTechnicals / _parse / load_technicals. Pinned copy per the P-07 pattern (metron-PR457, crucible-PR302).
